debit.sms: 'BLOCK <space> Last four digits of Debit Card' to 5676762 or 9895088888
debit.notes: Pan-India toll-free Contact Centre numbers per the dedicated block-ATM/debit-card page, which also states: 'Customers from abroad can dial +91-484-2630994 or +91-484-2630995'. SMS 'BLOCK <space> last four digits of the debit card' to 5676762 or 9895088888 gets an instant confirmation on the registered mobile number. FedMobile app path: Menu > Self Service > Block Debit Card (the bank's ways-to-block page words it Account Services > Manage Debit Cards > Block This Card). Netbanking (FedNet) path: Debit Card Services > Block Debit Card, select card, Submit. Branch visit is listed as a last resort.

credit.sms: 'FBCCBLOCK<Last 4 digits of credit card number>' to +91-9008915353
credit.notes: Same 24x7 Contact Centre numbers as debit; the credit-cards FAQ lists 'Resident Customers: 1800 420 1199, 1800 425 1199 - Non-Resident Customers: 0484 2630994'. SMS keyword FBCCBLOCK (bank's sms-banking table: 'Blocking credit card due to loss/theft/fraud transactions') goes to dedicated number +91-9008915353; the separate CCCANCEL keyword to +91-9873662838 is card cancellation/closure, not loss-theft blocking. Email card details to creditcards@federalbank.co.in. Netbanking (FedNet) path: Credit Card module on home screen > Manage Credit Card > Report Credit Card; the credit-cards page words it Credit Cards Tab > Manage Card > Manage Credit Card (block/unblock also via FedMobile).
